name: Multivariate Control Chart (Hotelling T²)
whenToUse: Monitor several correlated characteristics together: Hotelling T² flags rows whose combination is unusual even when each value alone is in control.
variablesHint: Two or more numeric columns — observations per row.
baselineHint: Number of baseline observations for mean vector and covariance (m > p required).
errTooFewRows: Too few complete rows — need at least p+1 = {p}+1 observations.
err_singular: The covariance matrix is singular: at least one variable is constant or can be computed from the others.
err_rowLengthMismatch: All rows must have the same number of values.
err_baselineTooSmall: The baseline phase needs more rows than variables.

invariants.uniqueColumnRefs: Each column may be chosen only once.
